answer: Resisting sybil attacks requires binding identity to continuous work rather than one-time signups. Fake identities arrive like a sudden gale storm, but they cannot sustain real effort. Each agent must leave a clear track, guiding peers like a sparrow. Validation relies on transparent ledgers where contributions are cross-examined, making forged records transparent like opal glass. Ongoing work, audit trails, and peer review ensure mass sybils cost more than any reward.
